title: 2026 Marketing Predictions CPG Brands 😱
transcript: My marketing predictions for 2026 for C P G. Brands number one creator volume will matter more than polished content. The biggest brands will stop obsessing over perfect dads and focus on producing thousands of creator assets every month. The brands with the most content velocity will win. No. 2 TikTok Shop will become the number one product discovery engine, drive retail demand, increase Amazon sales, generate meta creatives, and boost branded search. The Halo effect will become impossible to ignore. No. 3 founder LED brands will dominate attention. Consumers trust people more than brands now. Founders who become the face of content will massively outperform corporate style brands. No. 4 meta ads will look less like ads. Highest converting creatives will fill native educational crater. Shot low production and social first Polish commercials will continue losing effectiveness over time. No. 5 AI will explode creative output. Winning brands won't use A I. To replace creators. They'll use it to generate concepts, iterate hooks, create stats, test angles, faster launch, more U G C, and multiply creator content. Creative velocity will become the biggest competitive advantage in e commerce. No. 6 subscription plus retention economics will separate winners from losers. Brands with strong L T V. Can afford to outspend everyone else, which means bundles, memberships, replenishment, community and continuity offers will become even more important. No. 7 brands become media companies. The biggest CBG brands in 2026 won't feel like product companies. They'll feel like entertainment brands, education brands, Creator networks, communities attention is becoming the most valuable asset in e commerce and the world. But let me know what you think.
